display.purpose: Trip names and page heroes only.

title.purpose: Card titles, block labels, dialog headers.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, dropdowns, popovers, toasts only. Surfaces at rest are flat (The Overlay-Only Rule).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Ease-out-quart for state transitions, 150-250ms. No bounce, no choreography.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action: Sunset Coral with Ink text, never white.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.55 0.15 35); color: #ffffff; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.50 0.14 35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.50 0.13 35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action on Paper with a 1px border.

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.129 0.042 264.7); height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.929 0.013 255.5); border-radius: 8px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; width: 240px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.45 0.045 260); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.50 0.13 35); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: oklch(0.50 0.13 35); }

components.name: Card

narrative.overview: Travalava's interface is the table a group of friends gathers around the night they decide the trip is really happening — maps unfolded, everyone's hands in the plan, snacks at the edges. It is a product surface: standard, trustworthy controls (shadcn/ui vocabulary, one sans family, flat bordered surfaces) carry the work, while warmth lives in deliberate moments — a vote landing, a block committing, a friend joining. The tool stays quiet so the group's energy is the loudest thing on screen.
keyCharacteristics: Warm coral accent on a calm, bordered, paper-white surface
One type family (Geist) at a tight product scale
Group state — who voted, what's winning, what's locked — always legible at a glance
Delight reserved for moments (vote, commit, join), never ambient decoration
Mobile-first: planned on a laptop, checked from a beach

rules.name: The One Warm Voice Rule
rules.body: Sunset Coral is the only saturated color on any screen and covers ≤10% of it. Its rarity is what makes a vote landing feel like something.

rules.name: The Gradient Ban
rules.body: Color gradients are prohibited — on text, buttons, avatars, icons, everywhere. The legacy blue→purple avatar gradients are scheduled for removal, not imitation.

rules.name: The State-Is-Sacred Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red mean committed, pending, and error. They are never used decoratively, and color is never the sole carrier — always pair with an icon or a word.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist everywhere. No display fonts, no second sans, no script — at any size, for any occasion.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Rule
rules.body: If it doesn't float above the page, it doesn't cast a shadow. A card with a shadow at rest is a bug.

dos: Do keep Sunset Coral at terracotta depth (L <= 0.55) wherever it carries white text; tints carry ink.
Do make group state instantly scannable: voter names beside counts, a green Committed badge with a lock icon, member avatars with initials.
Do use skeletons that mirror layout while loading — never a lone centered spinner inside content.
Do keep motion 150-250ms, ease-out, state-driven, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every animation.
Do design empty states that teach: a new trip's itinerary should invite "create your days," not say "no data."
donts: Don't build corporate SaaS dashboards — no KPI stat cards, no gray enterprise density.
Don't imitate Booking.com / Expedia conversion UI — no urgency banners, deal badges, or countdown timers.
Don't ship the generic AI template — no purple-gradient heroes, no glassmorphism, no identical icon-card grids.
Don't use gradients anywhere (The Gradient Ban) — including the legacy blue→purple avatar gradients still in the code.
Don't use border-left thicker than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't put Muted Text in body copy or placeholders that must be read — it is metadata-only.
Don't reinvent standard controls for flavor; if shadcn/ui has it, use it.
